newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ruling coalition to win majority - BVA poll.
newsitem.headline: French ruling coalition to win majority - BVA poll.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of France's May 25/June 1 parlimentary election.

The telephone poll of 1,075 adults aged 18 and over was conducted by Louis Harris on May 9 and 10 for French weekly Paris Match, France 2 television and Europe 1 radio and made public on May 13. The figures in brackets give the change since a previous BVA poll.
NOTE - Poll only covers the 555 constituencies in metropolitan France, not the 22 seats in overseas departments and territories.
Twelve percent of those polled did not say how they would vote.
Forty-one percent of those surveyed said they wanted the left to win and a similar number said they wanted the ruling coalition to win.
